title: Notifications
subtitle: Updates about your account, newest first.
emptyText: We will let you know here when something changes in your account.

securityKinds.new_device: A sign-in from a new device

registration_completed.title: Welcome to Ledgerline
registration_completed.body: Your account is ready. Start with a deposit or take the tour.

deposit_detected.title: Deposit detected
deposit_detected.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} is waiting for network confirmations. Reference {{reference}}.

deposit_under_review.title: Deposit under review
deposit_under_review.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} is being checked by our compliance team. Reference {{reference}}.

deposit_credited.title: Deposit credited
deposit_credited.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} was added to your balance. It can be withdrawn after {{holdDays}} days.

deposit_rejected.title: Deposit not credited
deposit_rejected.body: Deposit {{reference}} was not credited. Contact support for details.

withdrawal_created.title: Withdrawal requested
withdrawal_created.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} is reserved while we review request {{reference}}.

withdrawal_approved.title: Withdrawal approved
withdrawal_approved.body: Request {{reference}} was approved and will be sent shortly.

withdrawal_completed.title: Withdrawal sent
withdrawal_completed.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} was confirmed on the blockchain. Reference {{reference}}.

withdrawal_rejected.title: Withdrawal rejected
withdrawal_rejected.body: Request {{reference}} was rejected and the amount is back in your available balance.

withdrawal_failed.title: Withdrawal failed
withdrawal_failed.body: Request {{reference}} could not be sent. The amount is back in your available balance.

withdrawal_cancelled.title: Withdrawal cancelled
withdrawal_cancelled.body: Request {{reference}} was cancelled and the amount is back in your available balance.

investment_result_posted.title: Result posted
investment_result_posted.body: A realised result of {{amount}} {{asset}} was posted to position {{reference}}.

investment_awaiting_settlement.title: Term ended
investment_awaiting_settlement.body: Position {{reference}} will be released when the result for its last period is posted.

investment_matured.title: Position released
investment_matured.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} from position {{reference}} is back in your available balance.

referral_reward_pending.title: Referral reward pending
referral_reward_pending.body: {{amount}} {{asset}} will be credited after the check period.

wallet_added.title: Withdrawal address added
wallet_added.body: "{{label}}" on {{network}} was added. If this was not you, contact support now.

support_reply.title: Support replied
support_reply.body: There is a new reply in request {{reference}}.

security_alert.title: Security alert
security_alert.body: {{kind}}. If this was not you, change your password and contact support.
